The '''Crystal Moon Restaurant''' was the name of a restaurant opened in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] following the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|death]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. It was established by two of Jabba's former employees, [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] and [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]], who used funds stolen from the late [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] treasury in order to open the restaurant.

The Crystal Moon was soon widely reputed to be the finest restaurant in Mos Eisley. Building on this initial success, the two soon expanded the Crystal Moon into a franchise with locations in Mos Eisley and [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] with more scattered along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. Through bad management and bad luck all were soon lost except for the two in Mos Eisley and Mos Entha.

The Crystal Moon in Mos Entha owed its survival to the covert patronage of hopeful crime lord [[Herogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Nasirii]] clan. Most of Mos Entha, including Porcellus and Malakili, remained ignorant of the fact that the Crystal Moon was actually a front for a Hutt crime lord due to the low profile that he kept.
